limits: Final autoplay baselines are captured by passive in-page timers and console events. No page evaluate, waitForFunction, locator inspection or other script-evaluation call occurs before first tap, because Playwright evaluation supplies user activation. Native AudioContexts and actual pointer/touch input are used. Browser automation is not physical iOS or a subjective listening test.
